canonical_name: Cauchy integral theorem family (exact contour and domain formulation open)
literal_source_claim_zh: 全纯函数沿闭曲线的积分为零
literal_source_claim_en: The integral of a holomorphic function along a closed curve is zero.
statement_blocker: The literal catalog gloss is false for f(z)=1/z on Complex minus zero around the unit circle. The catalog supplies no source edition and does not select filled-region containment, a simply connected domain, null-homotopy, zero winding numbers, a primitive, or a restricted triangle, rectangle, or disk form. It also leaves curve type and regularity, integral encoding, codomain, Cauchy versus Goursat assumptions, binders, and boundary cases open. Selecting a convenient pinned theorem now would silently repair, narrow, or substitute the received target.
domain_and_universes: Open: an approved source must fix the complex domain or filled contour, scalar Complex versus a complex Banach codomain, the curve or cycle object and its universe, topology and regularity, and every Lean typeclass.
conclusion: Prospective family only: a source-eligible holomorphic function has zero contour integral along every source-eligible closed curve or cycle. The eligibility condition and integral representation are unresolved.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve empty and disconnected domains, constant paths, zero-radius circles, degenerate rectangles, reversed orientation, self-intersections and retracing, punctured domains, boundary regularity, and cycle multiplicities.
